arm_policy: A=current competent stack; B=same plus KernelBender; fresh independent contexts, matched budgets and trusted inputs
search_units: Agent implementation attempts are independent units; GPU timing rounds are repeated measurements within one attempt.
budget_policy: Freeze model/settings, wall-clock/token budget, candidate/build count and controller-admitted GPU budget before either arm. Start one pair per family; at most one independent repeat pair per family for any claimed skill-level win. Record every failed attempt.

families.name: Reused local categorical transition
families.solver_visible_operator: A periodic one-dimensional population has a two-bit state at every site. Apply the explicitly supplied shared transition rule synchronously for T steps from the supplied states and mask. Return the required final states and selected aggregate specified by the contract. The rule is fixed during an epoch; all initial state values are valid.

proposed_cases.domain: all four states, boundary patterns and nontrivial masks; select a few discriminating cells, not the Cartesian product

families.evaluator_only_notes: Provide one explicit simple rule as a truth table over local state, one neighbor and mask bit. The CPU oracle executes simultaneous updates with double buffers and exact integer semantics. Preserve periodic boundaries. Do not choose a rule whose output is constant or intentionally fits only one canned answer. A scalar/library-style native baseline is independent from candidate code. Potential constructions include packed Boolean state, standard vectorization and finite lookup; none is mandatory.
families.objective: Complete epoch/transition/output latency, including representation entry/exit; report steady-state separately only with justified lifetime. Space is a separate metric.
must_validate: Full final-state equality and required aggregate
T=0 identity guard if included in contract
Updated masks/rule epochs cannot use stale state
families.leakage_note: Not identical to the instructional threshold example. Even so, this is transfer within a taught mechanism family, not proof of unconstrained invention.

families.name: Only squared response energy is observable
families.solver_visible_operator: For every query row x, return the squared Euclidean norm of xW. W is provided and fixed for the explicitly specified update epoch. Do not return xW. Inputs, output dtype, finite-precision tolerance and permitted reordering are fixed by the evaluator. Include parameter updates at the declared frequency.

proposed_cases.domain: bounded represented FP32 values with mixed signs and cancellation/stress cases within a documented finite output range

families.evaluator_only_notes: The independent oracle forms xW and its squared norm in binary64 over represented inputs. An alternative identity uses the Gram form x(WW^T)x^T, but this must never be leaked as a mandatory solution hint. It only implements the allowed observable when numerical rules permit it. A strict intermediate-rounding variant is a separate rejection/guard probe, not an excuse to relax tolerance. Preparation cost and changed W are included; retaining an incorrect stale Gram matrix fails. Other constructions may win.
families.objective: Whole update epoch cost and per-query latency under the same caller-defined aggregation; no free preparation. Compare to the best valid direct library+reduction path.
must_validate: Required operation cannot specialize to known benchmark vectors
families.leakage_note: A new quadratic observable differs from the installed two-linear-map example. Do not claim novelty solely because the algebraic identity is rediscovered.

families.name: Regular dense GEMM without special structure
families.solver_visible_operator: Compute the specified regular GEMM for arbitrary represented inputs with fixed numerical/shape contract and a strong valid library baseline. There is no special sparsity, reused output or permission to change the operation.

shapes: A moderate square case appropriate to the target
proposed_cases.note: Freeze sizes and baseline before exposing either arm; no need to challenge every library algorithm.

families.evaluator_only_notes: A correct conventional/library recommendation is successful control behavior. Count unnecessary design/candidate overhead. Do not force B to invent a custom kernel to receive a result.
families.objective: Best valid full operator within matched search budget; report design effort and regressions.
must_validate: Fresh input values and nontrivial alpha/beta where specified
No inferred data sparsity or changed precision
Baseline retained when nothing beats it
families.leakage_note: This is a restraint/overhead control, not a creativity challenge.

next_step: The implementing evaluator creates actual independent task code/contracts and admitted runner settings; no kernel or model trial was executed while preparing this package.
